added.summary: Compiles every pipeline the world draws with in the background, a few a frame, as three.js renderer.compileAsync: call it behind a loading screen and keep the screen up until og.loading.idle, so a level never compiles a pipeline in play. Presentation only.
LoadingStatus.pipelinesRequested and pipelinesReady count the pipelines compiled off the frame and those made, for a loading bar such as 41/96; both only go up.

fixed.summary: The engine splash shows the first frame's compile as "Preparing graphics 41/96" over the last 35 % of its bar, ready of requested, instead of a bar that sat in its last 8 % or went back while new pipelines were asked for. og:progress carries ready and requested with the present stage.
